# The Paradise Group

> DJ, lighting and event production crew from Carmel, Indiana (Paradise Group LLC). Plays bars, venue nights and takeovers, birthdays, graduations, school and community dances, and reunions across Carmel, Indianapolis and Bloomington.

- Services: DJ entertainment, lighting, sound, show flow, crowd engagement, social promotion.
- Every private event includes a live DJ, curated sets, high-quality audio, lighting and a PA for announcements.
- Pricing: flexible, based on event size, length and equipment. Quotes through the website form.
- Venues played: Yatagarasu Ramen Bar (residency from August 2025), Loren & Mari's (May 2026), Serendipity Martini Bar (August 2026), Ocean Sports Bar (300+ guests, September 2026).
- Team: Coyer Paradise (owner and DJ), Dylan Delise (event coordinator), Anthony Tambo (DJ and saxophonist).
- No phone or email is published; contact through the quote form or Instagram @paradisegroupx.
